en: A vintage color postcard showing a wide city boulevard lined with mid-20th-century modernist and neoclassical buildings. Several cars from the 1950s-1960s are parked on the right, and people are walking on the sidewalks. The left side of the image features a building with a visible sign written in Latin characters. The street is spacious, with green medians and trees, and the perspective looks down a grand avenue, possibly a notable city square or government district.
